basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: AI Solution Architect · Pre-Sales Enablement, Demos & PoCs · GCP · Business-to-Technology Translation · MBA
basics.summary: Solution architect who turns AI and cloud into things customers and partners can actually ship: functional demos, proofs of concept, and enablement, not slideware. 13+ years across public cloud (GCP and AWS: compute, networking, microservices, Kubernetes), most recently building production AI on GCP Vertex AI at LumApps. _jobApplication.jobTitle: Partner Solution Architect, Regional System Integrators
_jobApplication.jobDescription: Google Cloud, Zurich. Partner Solution Architect (pre-sales solution design authority) for priority Regional System Integrators (RSIs) and strategic partners across South geo clusters, acting as ecosystem co-pilot to Account Platform Customer Engineers. Own the partner's technical capability to deliver: move from regional advisory to deep domain execution (AI, Data, or Infrastructure) to capture the pre-sales gap while deflecting post-sales delivery. Work with Partner Development Managers on joint business plans. Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's or equivalent; 10 years of cloud-native architecture in a customer-facing or support role; public cloud architecture (compute, networking, IAM, microservices); pre-sales agreement acceleration, running technical PoCs, and leading technical workshops. Preferred: experience in AI, data, or infrastructure; enterprise technology buying/evaluation; large-scale computing and business-to-technology translation to challenge partner delivery strategies; cross-functional work with GCP Customer Engineers to orchestrate multi-product solutions; ability to drive and influence partner technical audiences, find expansion engagements, and accelerate agreement velocity with zero partner-delivery escalations. Responsibilities: drive VIP bootcamps and hackathons; provide pre-sales architectural support to RSIs/strategic partners; author baseline enterprise replicable assets (e.g., functional AI demos) and lead deep-dive technical sessions and hackathons for the Partner Technology Community (1-to-many enablement); help build/run the EMEA Partner Technology Community; technical review and validation of high-impact SoWs to ensure a path to production and partner funding ROI.
_jobApplication.notes: Positioned for AI-domain pre-sales solution architecture: GenAI demo system for Sales (Beekeeper) maps to 'author functional AI demos'; cloud-native architecture on GCP/AWS/Kubernetes/microservices; enablement via keynotes, workshops, teaching (1-to-many); partner/startup technical advisory (Tenity); MBA business-to-technology translation; ROI focus. Honest gaps NOT fabricated: no prior cloud-vendor partner/RSI pre-sales role, no formal SoW-validation-at-scale, and IAM depth is light (has compute/networking/microservices/Kubernetes). Bridged via demo-building, enablement, and cloud architecture experience.
